KEYS REQUIRED BEFORE PROCEEDING
You should have already collected your keys from 23 Lonsdale Street, Braddon before going to the property. If you don't have your keys yet, tap here for key collection instructions or call us on 0493 173 122.

Check-In Instructions

Choose your check-in route below.

Step 1
Your Keys
Your keyring has two items — a remote (opens the carpark garage and acts as a fob for all readers) and a standard door key (front door of the apartment).
Step 2
Head to 3 Towns Crescent
Head to 3 Towns Crescent, Turner. Look for the Vue East building — you will see the "VUE EAST" sign and the lobby entrance on the right.
Step 3
Swipe Remote to Enter
Hold your remote up to the reader on the door to unlock it and enter the building. Please note it may take up to 3 seconds to register — if it doesn't work, try again.
Step 4
Take the Lift to Level 2
Proceed right to the elevator. Press Level 2.
Step 5
Find Apartment 17
Turn left out of the elevator — Apartment 17 is on the left. Use your door key to enter. Enjoy your stay!
Step 1
Your Keys
Your keyring has two items — a remote (opens the carpark garage and acts as a fob for all readers) and a standard door key (front door of the apartment).
Step 2
Turn into Towns Crescent
Head to 3 Towns Crescent, Turner. Turn into Towns Crescent as shown.
Step 3
Open the Garage Door
You will see the garage door ahead. Go close to it and press the button on your remote to open it.
Step 4
Enter & Turn Left
Drive through the garage entry and turn left once inside.
Step 5
Go to the End, Turn Right
Go all the way to the end and turn right. Note the building elevator is also located here on your right — you will use it after parking.
Step 6
Park in Space 17
Continue all the way to the end. Car space 17 is the last space on the left.
Step 7
Take the Building Elevator
Once parked, walk back around to the building elevator you passed on the way in.
Step 8
Press Level 2
Press Level 2 inside the lift.
Step 9
Find Apartment 17
Turn left out of the elevator — Apartment 17 is on the left. Use your door key to enter. Enjoy your stay!
